page_subtitle: Domain fingerprinting, transfer performance, and known limitations

recommended_model_section.heading: full_canonical__lgbm — Best Known-Domain Prototype
recommended_model_section.summary: full_canonical__lgbm achieves near-perfect in-distribution detection (Pooled AUC = 0.9994) with honest capture-level evaluation and good calibration (ECE = 0.0026). It is the best deployment-eligible prototype from the final_transfer experiment.
recommended_model_section.limitation_note: However, it remains a known-domain / simulation-only prototype. Domain AUC = 1.0 and LODO-min AUC ≈ 0.616 confirm that dataset fingerprinting is structural and unresolved. The model should not be deployed in unseen network environments without further data collection.
recommended_model_section.simulation_notice: This model is simulation-only. No packets are blocked. All SIMULATED_BLOCK actions are audit/log events only.

domain_fingerprinting_section.heading: Domain Fingerprinting — Structural and Unresolved
explanation: The model achieves Domain AUC = 1.0, meaning it perfectly identifies which dataset a flow came from (ISCX, USBVPN, or VNAT). This is called dataset fingerprinting.

Fingerprinting arises because features such as fwd_pkt_len_mean, bwd_pkt_len_mean, and flow_iat_mean encode absolute network conditions that differ systematically across datasets (capture environment, VPN software version, OS, hardware).

This is not a bug or an artifact of the feature selection — it is structural. The datasets were captured in different environments at different times, and the model learns to discriminate datasets instead of (or in addition to) VPN traffic.

Consequence: the model's in-distribution performance (Pooled AUC = 0.9994) is partially inflated by this fingerprinting. When evaluated on unseen datasets (LODO), performance drops to LODO-min AUC = 0.616.

dann_experiment.heading: DANN Adversarial Training — Did Not Resolve Fingerprinting
dann_experiment.summary: DANN v2 (Domain-Adversarial Neural Network) was trained across 21 hyperparameter configurations with lambda annealing up to 5.0, balanced mini-batching, and an embedding-level domain classifier. The goal was to learn a domain-invariant representation.
dann_experiment.result: Best embedding_domain_auc remained ≈ 1.0. Domain reduction ≈ 0.0003. DANN failed to reduce dataset fingerprinting.
dann_experiment.conclusion: Dataset fingerprinting is structural and cannot be resolved by adversarial training alone. New capture environments are required.

lodo_section.heading: Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) Transfer Performance
lodo_section.description: LODO evaluation measures how well the model detects VPN traffic when an entire dataset is held out during training. This simulates deployment in a new network environment.

results.interpretation: Moderate transfer. When ISCX-VPN-2016 is held out, AUC drops to ~0.616 — only marginally above random. The three-tier FLAG_REVIEW band provides a safety buffer under domain shift.
Worse transfer despite lower domain_auc. Reducing fingerprinting without new data does not improve generalisation.

lodo_section.note: USBVPN LODO is not evaluated (single capture per class). All LODO evaluations use capture-level splits.

limitations.title: Known-Domain Only
limitations.description: The model was trained and evaluated on ISCX-VPN-2016, USBVPN, and VNAT. Performance on unseen deployment environments is unknown. Domain AUC = 1.0 confirms this.

limitations.title: Structural Dataset Fingerprinting
limitations.description: Domain AUC = 1.0. The model memorises dataset origin. DANN adversarial training did not resolve this. New capture environments are required.

limitations.title: Moderate Transfer Performance
limitations.description: LODO-min AUC = 0.616. When ISCX-VPN-2016 is held out, detection is only marginally better than random. The FLAG_REVIEW uncertainty band partially mitigates this.

limitations.title: Simulation Only — No Real Packet Blocking
limitations.description: All SIMULATED_BLOCK decisions are log/alert actions. No real packets are blocked. This system has no integration with any packet-filtering or firewall infrastructure. Not production-ready.

limitations.title: Small Threshold Validation Set
limitations.description: Thresholds derived from 101 sessions (100 benign + 1 VPN). With a richer validation set, thresholds should be recomputed.

limitations.title: Feature Extraction Dependency
limitations.description: Requires the same CICFlowMeter-compatible feature pipeline used during training. Feature order is specified in feature_order.json. Any change to extraction parameters will degrade performance.

legacy_model_section.heading: Legacy Baseline: robust9_firewall
legacy_model_section.note: robust9_firewall is retained as a legacy/historical baseline for comparison purposes only. It is not the recommended model and has been superseded by full_canonical__lgbm. No LODO or domain-fingerprinting evaluation is available for robust9.
legacy_model_section.simulation_notice: robust9_firewall is also simulation-only. No packets are blocked.

items.title: New Capture Environments
items.description: Collect VPN traffic from 2–3 additional OS/hardware/network configurations. Domain AUC will only drop when feature distributions overlap across environments.

items.title: Modern VPN Protocols
items.description: Add WireGuard, QUIC-over-VPN captures. Current datasets are OpenVPN/PPTP-era.

items.title: relative_shape_v2 + GroupDRO
items.description: Ratio/CV features + iterative worst-domain reweighting. Target: LODO-min AUC > 0.616 without new data.

items.title: Packet-Sequence Models
items.description: CNN/LSTM on per-packet byte sequences instead of flow statistics. Reduces absolute-scale dependence.

items.title: Concept Drift Monitoring
items.description: Deploy with a domain-shift detector. Alert when incoming flow statistics diverge from training distribution.
